text.스펙 문서를 쓰고 작업 목록·계획·추적 표로 본다: Write spec documents and view them as task lists, plans and trace tables
Storage location, names and limits of the specs feature (server administrator values).
text.스펙을 저장하는 정의 종류의 이름. 바꾸면 이미 있는 스펙을 찾지 못한다: Name of the definition kind that stores specs. If changed, existing specs can't be found.
Change this only if it clashes with another feature's definition kind name.
text.문서 틀을 저장하는 정의 종류의 이름. 바꾸면 이미 있는 틀을 찾지 못한: Name of the definition kind that stores document templates. If changed, existing templates can't be found.
text.저장 공간(프로젝트 구성 폴더 또는 단독 루트) 안에서 스펙을 두는 폴더: Folder for specs inside the storage space (project config folder or standalone root).
Set this when you want a different spec folder name.
Folder for document templates inside the storage space.
Set this when you want a different template folder name.
text.프로젝트 연동이 없을 때 스펙을 두는 폴더. 비우면 워크스페이스 안 기본: Folder for specs when there's no projects integration. Leave empty for the default folder in the workspace. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder.
Set this to change the storage location when you use only the specs feature without projects.
text.작업 실행에 붙이는 라벨 키의 앞부분. 바꾸면 이전 실행과의 연결이 끊긴: Beginning of the label key added to task runs. If changed, links to earlier runs are lost.
Change this only if it clashes with another feature's run labels.
text.실행 화면에 라벨을 칩으로 보이는 규칙(키는 접두를 뺀 이름). 비우면: Rules for showing labels as chips on run screens (keys are names without the prefix). Leave empty for the default rules; an empty list shows no chips.
Set this to change the names or order of label chips on run screens.
Maximum number of ready tasks that can be started at once.
Raise this when you need to start more tasks at once.
Maximum number of tasks read from one spec. Above it, the rest aren't read and you're told.
Raise this when you write very large task documents.
text.문서 하나의 작업을 읽는 최대 시간. 넘으면 그 문서의 작업만 빼고 알린: Maximum time to read the tasks of one document. Above it, only that document's tasks are left out and you're told.
Raise this when large documents get cut off on a slow computer.
text.문서가 바뀌지 않았으면 다시 읽지 않도록 보관할 스펙 수. 0이면 보관하: Number of specs whose read results are kept so unchanged documents aren't read again. 0 keeps none.
Lower this when you have a great many specs and want to use less memory.
File extensions shown in the import-from-folder list (dot included).
Add more when you want to import documents with other extensions too.
Maximum number of files shown at once in the import-from-folder list.
text.서버가 묶인 주소(서버 설정 host를 이어받는다). 루프백이 아니면 폴: Address the server is bound to (inherits host from the server settings). If it isn't loopback, folder file lists aren't shown. Empty means loopback.
